blind.description: A stylized wooden half-barrel planter filled with lush green foliage and small blooming flowers. The barrel is made of brown vertical wooden staves held together by two dark grey metal hoops with metallic rivets. Emerging from the top rim is a rounded dome of green leaves interspersed with four-petaled red/orange and pale yellow/cream flowers with yellow centers. The geometry is clean, continuous, and solid, stylized in a cartoon/game asset aesthetic, sitting flat directly on the ground without an extraneous base.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a circular bush of dense green leaves surrounded by a ring of small orange/red and pale yellow flowers, casting a leafy shadow to the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.35 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 feet tall) and about 1.5 to 2 times the width of the figure's diameter.
